summary.text: In February 2025 remarks at the AI Action Summit, Vice President JD Vance said the administration would block efforts to steal or misuse American AI and chip technologies and would work with allies to strengthen protections. In X posts, Vance criticized political bias in AI models, said fear of AI-caused mass unemployment distracts from job losses through trade, and said AI risks are either overstated or difficult to avoid. In a May 2026 X post, Vance said that in navigating an AI battlefield, matters of life and death must not be outsourced to machines. Official Vice President account posts in 2026 quoted Vance discussing superintelligence companies and saying AI tools should work without absolving companies, while also emphasizing giving workers a voice in wealth creation.
